thread:
erin_ml: Trying to bring mpt-7b-qat into the eval harness, CI runner passes locally but fails in the pipeline with metric diffs
sam_engineer: what do the diffs look like? numeric delta or missing outputs?
erin_ml: It's weird — token counts fine, but our QA metrics (exact-match and a small rouge-ish aggregate) flip for a subset of prompts. More failures when quant profile = q4_0
jin_eval: could be rounding in logits leading to different argmaxes after sampling. Are we running the same sampling seeds across runners?
erin_ml: yes, deterministic sampling enabled. Also noticed chat-template placeholders get escaped differently: "<|user|>" vs "<|user|>\n" depending on tokenizer config
sam_engineer: ah, tokenizer config mismatch in the CI container image? maybe byte-level preprocessing differs for the quant pipeline
alex_platform: ops-bot flagged a different python/transformers wheel in the quant-runner image earlier today, build 2026.02.14. I can pin to the validated wheel for a smoke run
ops-bot: CI job #589 on runner-quant failed: exit 1. Artifacts: /artifacts/589/outputs.json, /artifacts/589/log.txt
jin_eval: can you upload the outputs.json? I want to diff model logits + tokenization offsets for the failing prompts
erin_ml: uploaded gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/abcd1234 — includes sample inputs, outputs from host runner and ci runner, and the quant config
sam_engineer: quick glance — host-runner outputs have some extra leading whitespace tokens that shift alignments. That explains rouge/EM drop for a few cases
alex_platform: I'll repro locally with the CI image and run the tokenizer-only unit to see if byte-level normalization changed
jin_eval: in the meantime, suggest adding a lightweight end-to-end smoke test to the eval CI: run 10 canonical prompts with exact-match thresholds and fail fast on >2 regressions. It'll catch these config drift cases earlier
erin_ml: agreed. I'll draft the job and add a tokenization checksum step so we assert tokenizer.vocab_size + normalization_hash is stable across images
sam_engineer: also add a flag to runner to emit token offsets in the output bundle for easier diffs
alex_platform: creating a branch to pin transformers wheel and run the smoke job. tagging @eng-ml when done
jin_eval: thanks — once we confirm, we should add a short note to onboarding checklist for new model configs: specify tokenizer_norm, special_token_serialization, and quant_profile used in eval runs
erin_ml: sounds good. will follow up with PR and the failing-case minimal repro for the model owners
sam_engineer: :thumbsup
